data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 书架上层的意外发现
data.description: 周末图书馆里，爱瑠穿浅绿开衫和深灰长裙，站在低矮稳固的梯凳上抽出一本旧书。她用另一只手扶住书架，发现书页间露出一片干叶，紫眼立刻认真睁大，长黑发顺着肩背落下。
data.action: 扶稳书架抽出旧书，惊喜地发现夹在书页间的干叶。
data.promptProse: Standing on a low stable library step stool, Eru Chitanda steadies herself against the shelf with one hand and draws out an old book with the other. A dry leaf protruding from its pages catches her purple-eyed attention. Her pale-green cardigan and charcoal skirt remain visible in the medium portrait. Soft aisle light illuminates the leaf edge and long black hair, with shelf recesses dark behind the book and a grounded shadow beneath the stool.
